description:
Free discovery (capped teaser): the top-N merchants a wallet actually pays, by
    event count, with per-edge tx_count / total_usdc / first+last timestamps.

    See WHO a counterparty transacts with before trusting it. The list is capped
    (default 10, max 25) and `capped`/`total_distinct_merchants` disclose how much
    is withheld; the FULL deduped payment graph and numeric edge weights are part
    of the paid intel surface (GET /v1/intel/trust/{wallet}). Fail-open.

limit.description: Max counterparties to return (default 10, hard cap 25 - this is a capped teaser).
limit.title: Limit

wallet.description: Payer Solana wallet public key (32-44 base58 chars) whose counterparties (merchants paid) to list.
wallet.title: Wallet

name: get_counterparties

capped.description: True if the full merchant set exceeds the returned list.
capped.title: Capped

counterparties.description: Capped top-N merchants paid, each with tx_count, total_usdc, first_at, last_at.
counterparties.title: Counterparties

data_available.description: False when the corpus/DB was unavailable.
data_available.title: Data Available

error.description: Present only on the degraded path.
error.title: Error

teaser_note.description: States that the full deduped graph + edge weights are paid.
teaser_note.title: Teaser Note

total_distinct_merchants.description: Total distinct merchants this payer has paid (full, uncapped).
total_distinct_merchants.title: Total Distinct Merchants

total_events.description: Total observed payment events for this payer.
total_events.title: Total Events
